item.title: Telephone conversation with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran
item.description: On March 23, 2026, a telephone conversation took place between the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan Rashid Meredov and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran Abbas Araghchi.

item.title: Official website launched for “Young naturalist” public organization
item.description: Amidst the season of nature's awakening and vibrant bloom, the official website of the “Young naturalist” public organization — has officially commenced its operations.

item.title: Meeting held at the MFA of Turkmenistan with the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uganda
item.description: On 24 March 2026, a meeting was held at the MFA of Turkmenistan between the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan Rashid Meredov, and the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uganda Henry Oryem Okello.

item.title: In April, the Institute of world languages of Turkmenistan will host three international events
item.description: The Turkmen national institute of world languages named after Dovletmammet Azady, with the support of the Ministry of education of Turkmenistan, will hold three international events in April: an Olympiad and two conferences.

item.title: A student from a Mary vocational school won the «Best student of Central Asia» competition
item.description: Maksatmyrat Yardymov, a II-year student majoring in «Economics and digital information technology» at the Mary velayat financial and economic secondary vocational school, won the international competition «Best student of Central Asia», which took place on the 21st of March in Astana, Kazakhstan.

item.title: Durable Artificial Turf from WMGrass Showcased at Exhibition in Ashgabat
item.description: The universal international exhibition “Cooperation and Development,” which opened in Ashgabat, has become an effective business platform for establishing direct contacts between Turkmen and foreign companies.
